recommendation: BH1750 alone cannot evaluate plant_light against this corpus. It becomes conditionally evaluable only through a separately stored PPFD estimate from a field-validated coefficient for the exact fixed LED–sensor–geometry state; mixed daylight remains measurement-basis blocked, and DLI requires a wholly valid integration window.
why: The quarantined lux record identifies unit transfer—not low light—as the failure; raw lux supports no corpus light boundary.
Approval requires simultaneous, co-planar BH1750 and calibrated quantum-reference measurements across the operating range; one paired observation is insufficient.
Any PPFD comparison still inherits the record's objective, cultivar/stage, environment, photoperiod, temporal-window, and claim-role gates.
Uncertainty is a separate admission gate: if its interval crosses a boundary or tested-domain edge, the result is indeterminate—not good or bad.
The 6 °C temperature grid is dimensionally irrelevant. If 20% remains, it equals 100 PPFD at 500 and nearly spans the 150–200 band.
sketch:
-- PRECONDITIONS
-- 1. A context is eligible only while daylight is physically excluded and LED spectrum,
--    channel mix/drive profile, geometry, sensor identity, and operating range match calibration.
-- 2. A one-time initial calibration is a co-located/coplanar sweep against a calibrated
--    400–700 nm quantum sensor over representative intensities and positions. Fit P=kL,
--    residuals and uncertainty. Freeze validity-domain fingerprints and expiry.
-- 3. Daylit mixed operation cannot use that coefficient. Verified blackout or night-only
--    LED operation may create a separate fixed_led_only context; mixed-light DLI remains blocked.

PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

CREATE TABLE light_sensor (
  sensor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(sensor_id GLOB 'sensor:*'),
  model TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(model = 'BH1750'),
  serial_number TEXT NOT NULL,
  firmware_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  verification_date TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE crop_batch_context (
  batch_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(batch_id GLOB 'batch:*'),
  crop TEXT NOT NULL,
  scientific_name TEXT,
  cultivar TEXT,
  growth_stage TEXT NOT NULL,
  sowing_or_transplant_date TEXT,
  cultivation_system TEXT NOT NULL,
  production_objective TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE light_context (
  context_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(context_id GLOB 'ctx:*'),
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  zone_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_mode IN
    ('fixed_led_only','mixed_daylight_led','daylight_only','unknown')),
  daylight_excluded INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(daylight_excluded IN (0,1)),
  led_source_id TEXT,
  spectrum_fingerprint TEXT,
  drive_profile_fingerprint TEXT,
  geometry_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  measurement_height_m REAL NOT NULL CHECK(measurement_height_m >= 0),
  sensor_orientation TEXT NOT NULL,
  indoor_or_outdoor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(indoor_or_outdoor IN ('indoor','outdoor')),
  valid_from_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  valid_to_utc TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(valid_to_utc > valid_from_utc),
  CHECK(source_mode <> 'fixed_led_only' OR
    (daylight_excluded = 1 AND led_source_id IS NOT NULL AND
     spectrum_fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND drive_profile_fingerprint IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE raw_lux_reading (
  lux_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(lux_id GLOB 'lux:*'),
  sensor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES light_sensor(sensor_id),
  context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES light_context(context_id),
  batch_id TEXT REFERENCES crop_batch_context(batch_id),
  timestamp_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  lux_value REAL NOT NULL CHECK(lux_value >= 0),
  u_lux_std_lx REAL CHECK(u_lux_std_lx >= 0),
  unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lx' CHECK(unit = 'lx'),
  quality_flag TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(quality_flag IN
    ('valid','suspect','saturated','out_of_range'))
) STRICT;

-- The coefficient is itself a versioned measurement with uncertainty and domain.
CREATE TABLE ppfd_conversion_calibration (
  calibration_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(calibration_id GLOB 'cal:*'),
  sensor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES light_sensor(sensor_id),
  context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES light_context(context_id),
  spectrum_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  drive_profile_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  geometry_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  k_ppfd_per_lux REAL NOT NULL CHECK(k_ppfd_per_lux > 0),
  u_k_std REAL NOT NULL CHECK(u_k_std >= 0),
  fit_residual_ppfd_std REAL NOT NULL CHECK(fit_residual_ppfd_std >= 0),
  lux_min REAL NOT NULL CHECK(lux_min >= 0),
  lux_max REAL NOT NULL CHECK(lux_max > lux_min),
  paired_observation_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(paired_observation_count >= 3),
  spatial_position_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(spatial_position_count >= 1),
  reference_quantum_sensor_serial TEXT,
  reference_calibration_date TEXT,
  validation_protocol TEXT,
  validated_at_utc TEXT,
  valid_from_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  valid_to_utc TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(valid_to_utc > valid_from_utc),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft','approved','retired','revoked')),
  validity_notes TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(calibration_id, sensor_id, context_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TRIGGER calibration_approval_insert_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON ppfd_conversion_calibration
WHEN NEW.status = 'approved'
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.reference_quantum_sensor_serial IS NULL
                    OR NEW.reference_calibration_date IS NULL
                    OR NEW.validation_protocol IS NULL
                    OR NEW.validated_at_utc IS NULL
                    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM light_context c
      WHERE c.context_id = NEW.context_id
        AND c.source_mode = 'fixed_led_only'
        AND c.daylight_excluded = 1
        AND c.spectrum_fingerprint = NEW.spectrum_fingerprint
        AND c.drive_profile_fingerprint = NEW.drive_profile_fingerprint
        AND c.geometry_fingerprint = NEW.geometry_fingerprint
    )
    THEN RAISE(ABORT,'conversion requires validated fixed-LED context') END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER calibration_approval_update_guard
BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON ppfd_conversion_calibration
WHEN NEW.status = 'approved'
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.reference_quantum_sensor_serial IS NULL
                    OR NEW.reference_calibration_date IS NULL
                    OR NEW.validation_protocol IS NULL
                    OR NEW.validated_at_utc IS NULL
                    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM light_context c
      WHERE c.context_id = NEW.context_id
        AND c.source_mode = 'fixed_led_only'
        AND c.daylight_excluded = 1
        AND c.spectrum_fingerprint = NEW.spectrum_fingerprint
        AND c.drive_profile_fingerprint = NEW.drive_profile_fingerprint
        AND c.geometry_fingerprint = NEW.geometry_fingerprint
    )
    THEN RAISE(ABORT,'conversion requires validated fixed-LED context') END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER approved_context_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE ON light_context
WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM ppfd_conversion_calibration c
  WHERE c.context_id = OLD.context_id AND c.status = 'approved'
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'create a new context and calibration version');
END;

CREATE TABLE derived_ppfd (
  ppfd_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(ppfd_id GLOB 'ppfd:*'),
  lux_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES raw_lux_reading(lux_id),
  calibration_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ppfd_conversion_calibration(calibration_id),
  ppfd_value REAL NOT NULL CHECK(ppfd_value >= 0),
  u_ppfd_std REAL NOT NULL CHECK(u_ppfd_std >= 0),
  coverage_factor REAL NOT NULL CHECK(coverage_factor >= 1),
  expanded_uncertainty_ppfd REAL NOT NULL CHECK(expanded_uncertainty_ppfd >= 0),
  unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'umol_m-2_s-1'
       CHECK(unit = 'umol_m-2_s-1'),
  CHECK(abs(expanded_uncertainty_ppfd - coverage_factor*u_ppfd_std)
        <= 0.000001*max(1.0,expanded_uncertainty_ppfd))
) STRICT;

-- Assumes independent uncertainty components:
-- u(P)^2=(k*u(L))^2+(L*u(k))^2+u(fit)^2. Store covariance instead if needed.
CREATE TRIGGER derived_ppfd_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON derived_ppfd
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM raw_lux_reading l
    JOIN ppfd_conversion_calibration c
      ON c.calibration_id = NEW.calibration_id
     AND c.sensor_id = l.sensor_id AND c.context_id = l.context_id
    JOIN light_context x ON x.context_id = l.context_id
    WHERE l.lux_id = NEW.lux_id
      AND l.quality_flag = 'valid' AND l.u_lux_std_lx IS NOT NULL
      AND c.status = 'approved'
      AND x.source_mode = 'fixed_led_only' AND x.daylight_excluded = 1
      AND l.timestamp_utc >= c.valid_from_utc
      AND l.timestamp_utc < c.valid_to_utc
      AND l.lux_value BETWEEN c.lux_min AND c.lux_max
      AND abs(NEW.ppfd_value-c.k_ppfd_per_lux*l.lux_value)
          <= 0.000001*max(1.0,NEW.ppfd_value)
      AND abs(NEW.u_ppfd_std*NEW.u_ppfd_std -
          (c.k_ppfd_per_lux*c.k_ppfd_per_lux*l.u_lux_std_lx*l.u_lux_std_lx +
           l.lux_value*l.lux_value*c.u_k_std*c.u_k_std +
           c.fit_residual_ppfd_std*c.fit_residual_ppfd_std))
          <= 0.000001*max(1.0,NEW.u_ppfd_std*NEW.u_ppfd_std)
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'inadmissible lux-to-PPFD derivation') END;
END;

-- PPFD and DLI evidence projections are dimension-specific; the quarantined lux
-- record is never projected into either table.
CREATE TABLE ppfd_reference (
  ppfd_ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(ppfd_ref_id GLOB 'ref:ppfd:*'),
  evidence_record_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  claim_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(claim_role IN
    ('comparative_best_tested_point','comparative_suitable_band',
     'author_recommended_target')),
  claim_shape TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(claim_shape IN ('point','band')),
  target_ppfd REAL,
  band_min_ppfd REAL,
  band_max_ppfd REAL,
  tested_grid_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  tested_min_ppfd REAL,
  tested_max_ppfd REAL,
  photoperiod_hours REAL NOT NULL,
  record_context_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  prohibited_use TEXT NOT NULL,
  unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'umol_m-2_s-1'
       CHECK(unit = 'umol_m-2_s-1'),
  CHECK((claim_shape='point' AND target_ppfd IS NOT NULL AND
         band_min_ppfd IS NULL AND band_max_ppfd IS NULL) OR
        (claim_shape='band' AND target_ppfd IS NULL AND
         band_min_ppfd IS NOT NULL AND band_max_ppfd > band_min_ppfd))
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE dli_reference (
  dli_ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(dli_ref_id GLOB 'ref:dli:*'),
  evidence_record_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  claim_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(claim_role='author_recommended_target'),
  target_dli REAL NOT NULL CHECK(target_dli >= 0),
  record_context_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  prohibited_use TEXT NOT NULL,
  unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mol_m-2_day-1'
       CHECK(unit = 'mol_m-2_day-1')
) STRICT;

-- Every biological/context gate must pass before a comparison request can exist.
CREATE TABLE ppfd_context_admission (
  admission_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(admission_id GLOB 'admit:ppfd:*'),
  ppfd_ref_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ppfd_reference(ppfd_ref_id),
  batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES crop_batch_context(batch_id),
  objective_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(objective_match IN (0,1)),
  cultivar_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(cultivar_match IN (0,1)),
  growth_stage_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(growth_stage_match IN (0,1)),
  environment_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(environment_match IN (0,1)),
  measurement_basis_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(measurement_basis_match IN (0,1)),
  temporal_window_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(temporal_window_match IN (0,1)),
  admitted INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS
    (CASE WHEN objective_match=1 AND cultivar_match=1 AND growth_stage_match=1
                AND environment_match=1 AND measurement_basis_match=1
                AND temporal_window_match=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) STORED,
  UNIQUE(admission_id,admitted)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE ppfd_evaluation_request (
  request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(request_id GLOB 'eval:ppfd:*'),
  ppfd_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derived_ppfd(ppfd_id),
  admission_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  admitted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(admitted=1),
  FOREIGN KEY(admission_id,admitted)
    REFERENCES ppfd_context_admission(admission_id,admitted)
) STRICT;

CREATE VIEW v_ppfd_context_gated_result AS
SELECT q.request_id, d.ppfd_value, d.expanded_uncertainty_ppfd,
       r.evidence_record_id, r.claim_role,
 CASE
  WHEN r.tested_min_ppfd IS NOT NULL AND
       (d.ppfd_value+d.expanded_uncertainty_ppfd < r.tested_min_ppfd OR
        d.ppfd_value-d.expanded_uncertainty_ppfd > r.tested_max_ppfd)
    THEN 'unknown_untested_region'
  WHEN r.tested_min_ppfd IS NOT NULL AND
       (d.ppfd_value-d.expanded_uncertainty_ppfd < r.tested_min_ppfd OR
        d.ppfd_value+d.expanded_uncertainty_ppfd > r.tested_max_ppfd)
    THEN 'indeterminate_tested_domain_edge'
  WHEN r.claim_shape='point' AND r.claim_role='comparative_best_tested_point'
    THEN 'distance_to_tested_argmax_only_no_interpolation'
  WHEN r.claim_shape='point'
    THEN 'distance_to_author_target_only'
  WHEN d.ppfd_value-d.expanded_uncertainty_ppfd >= r.band_min_ppfd AND
       d.ppfd_value+d.expanded_uncertainty_ppfd <= r.band_max_ppfd
    THEN 'inside_claimed_band_not_a_score'
  WHEN d.ppfd_value+d.expanded_uncertainty_ppfd < r.band_min_ppfd OR
       d.ppfd_value-d.expanded_uncertainty_ppfd > r.band_max_ppfd
    THEN 'outside_claimed_band_outcome_not_bad'
  ELSE 'indeterminate_uncertainty_overlaps_band'
 END AS state
FROM ppfd_evaluation_request q
JOIN derived_ppfd d ON d.ppfd_id=q.ppfd_id
JOIN ppfd_context_admission a ON a.admission_id=q.admission_id AND a.admitted=1
JOIN ppfd_reference r ON r.ppfd_ref_id=a.ppfd_ref_id;

-- DLI can consume only admitted derived PPFD rows, never raw lux.
CREATE TABLE dli_window (
  window_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(window_id GLOB 'dliw:*'),
  context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES light_context(context_id),
  batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES crop_batch_context(batch_id),
  local_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  expected_lit_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expected_lit_seconds > 0)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE dli_ppfd_member (
  window_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dli_window(window_id),
  ppfd_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derived_ppfd(ppfd_id),
  represented_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(represented_seconds > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY(window_id,ppfd_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TRIGGER dli_member_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON dli_ppfd_member
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM dli_window w
    JOIN derived_ppfd p ON p.ppfd_id=NEW.ppfd_id
    JOIN raw_lux_reading l ON l.lux_id=p.lux_id
    WHERE w.window_id=NEW.window_id AND w.context_id=l.context_id
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'DLI member has wrong context or measurement basis') END;
END;

CREATE VIEW v_derived_dli AS
SELECT w.window_id, w.batch_id,
       sum(m.represented_seconds) AS covered_seconds,
       CASE WHEN sum(m.represented_seconds)=w.expected_lit_seconds
            THEN sum(p.ppfd_value*m.represented_seconds)/1000000.0 END AS dli_value,
       CASE WHEN sum(m.represented_seconds)=w.expected_lit_seconds
            THEN sum(p.expanded_uncertainty_ppfd*m.represented_seconds)/1000000.0 END
            AS conservative_expanded_uncertainty_dli,
       CASE WHEN sum(m.represented_seconds)=w.expected_lit_seconds
            THEN 'derived_complete_fixed_spectrum_window'
            ELSE 'blocked_incomplete_or_mixed_spectrum_window' END AS state,
       'mol_m-2_day-1' AS unit
FROM dli_window w
LEFT JOIN dli_ppfd_member m ON m.window_id=w.window_id
LEFT JOIN derived_ppfd p ON p.ppfd_id=m.ppfd_id
GROUP BY w.window_id;

-- Operational states:
-- RAW_LUX_ONLY -> useful non-scoring channel.
-- BLOCKED_VARIABLE_SPECTRUM -> mixed daylight or changed LED state.
-- BLOCKED_NO_VALID_CONVERSION -> absent/expired/out-of-range calibration.
-- DERIVED_PPFD_WITH_UNCERTAINTY -> measurement basis admitted.
-- BLOCKED_RECORD_CONTEXT -> one or more biological/temporal gates failed.
-- INDETERMINATE_UNCERTAINTY -> interval crosses the relevant domain/band.
-- DISTANCE_TO_TESTED_ARGMAX_ONLY -> no interpolation/extrapolation; untested is unknown.
-- BLOCKED_DLI_COVERAGE -> any part of the integration window lacks admissible PPFD.

-- Unit safety: raw_lux_reading, derived_ppfd, ppfd_reference, and dli_reference
-- have fixed unit columns and disjoint prefixed IDs. Evaluation requests have FKs
-- only to same-quantity tables. SQLite cannot prohibit a privileged arbitrary
-- expression such as SELECT lux_value > target_ppfd; production connections must
-- expose only the typed views or install an sqlite3 authorizer denying direct
-- cross-table reads.

plant_light_verdict.what_the_operator_sees: Before admission: `plant_light=measurement_basis_blocked`, lux, quality/saturation, source state, and fixed-source relative trend; PPFD/DLI are unavailable, never zero or poor. After admission: PPFD estimate ± expanded uncertainty and record-specific gate state; DLI appears only for complete valid windows.
plant_light_verdict.what_dies: Universal lux thresholds, raw-lux comparison with 500/150–200/140/200 PPFD or 11.5 DLI, generic conversion factors, mixed-daylight PPFD inference, and any claim that untested regions are bad.

assumptions: Source state, daylight exclusion, LED drive mix, and geometry can be identified per reading.
Calibration uses the deployed sensor and avoids double-counting correlated uncertainty components.
Crop objective, cultivar/stage, environment, and photoperiod are captured for admission gates.
risks: Daylight leakage, LED replacement, dimming-mode changes, temperature, or aging can silently invalidate the coefficient.
BH1750 saturation, spatial nonuniformity, and device drift may dominate an initially good fit.
Combined uncertainty may leave many readings indeterminate, especially near 150–200 or 500 PPFD references.
DDL protects stored evaluation paths; unrestricted ad-hoc SQLite still requires views or an authorizer for unit safety.
cheap_validation: Run one 45-minute reachability screen: exclude daylight, co-place the BH1750 and a calibrated quantum sensor at canopy plane, collect at least three repeats at five LED levels spanning operation, fit k and combined uncertainty, and fail the screen on saturation or residual/ratio variation exceeding the predeclared PPFD decision margin.
change_mind_if: I would change conditional yes to no for this deployment if the paired sweep cannot produce useful uncertainty within the operating range or any evaluated window has unseparated daylight/source changes; broader admission would require independently validated spectral compensation, not a generic lux factor.
